summary: The compliance review of the QuickLine product feature identified three key findings against the reviewed RBI rules. The first finding (medium severity) relates to the lack of explicit mention of loan disbursement into the borrower's bank account, which is required under DLD2025:9(i). The second and third findings (high severity) highlight non-compliance with DLD2025:19(ii) and DLD2025:9(ii), respectively. These findings indicate that the product feature may not meet the regulatory requirements for credit underwriting, disbursement, and repayment processes.
